_note: PLACEHOLDERS. Replace with the official 8 criteria, weights, scales and N/A conditions.

criteria.name: Needs identification
criteria.description: Operator asks clarifying questions to understand the client's need before offering anything.

criteria.name: Product presentation
criteria.description: Operator presents a suitable product with its key terms.
criteria.na_condition: Client did not need any product information.

criteria.name: Objection handling
criteria.description: Operator answers client objections with arguments.

criteria.name: Compliance and risk disclosure
criteria.description: Operator mentions risks and does not promise returns.

criteria.name: Next step agreed
criteria.description: Operator agrees a concrete next step with the client.

criteria.name: Farewell
criteria.description: Operator thanks the client and closes the conversation politely.

critical_error.description: Rudeness, deliberate misinformation, guaranteeing returns, or disclosing confidential data.
